verdict.rationale: Poly is a cloud file-storage and AI workspace, so letting users choose a storage region or data residency is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents region selection or residency controls. Local sync and pinning ('Keep Downloaded') only control on-device caching, not where data is stored server-side, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
